headline: Recommended paying two claims and denying six others, referring five to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation and one to the railroad company.
summary: The committee reviewed claims for vehicle, property, and road-related damage. It recommended paying two claims, totaling $1,301.83 and $2,100.00. It recommended denying six claims and referring them to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation or the Providence & Worcester Railroad Company, with 2-0 votes.
decisions: Recommended paying two claims: Cody Tavares by Progressive Subrogation, $1,301.83 (fire vehicle), and Antonia Ramos & Gerson Dos Santos, $2,100.00 (vehicle damage). Vote was 2-0.
Recommended denying five claims and referring them to JR Vinagro Construction Corporation. Vote was 2-0.
Recommended denying one claim and referring it to the Providence & Worcester Railroad Company. Vote was 2-0.

PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
COMMITTEE ON CLAIMS AND PENDING SUITS 
October 7, 2026 
 
A meeting of the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits was held Wednesday October 7, 2026, 
at 6:26 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Office, Room 204, 2nd Floor, 100 Freight St., 
Pawtucket, RI.   
 
Present – Councilor Rubio, Chair; and Councilor Araujo. 
 
Absent – Councilor Moreno. 
 
Councilor Rubio presided.  
 
Also present were Chris Crawley, Acting Director of Public Works; and Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., 
City Solicitor. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers.

NOES — 0.
